reason: The README clearly describes a Harness plugin that provides public web search as its primary research tool, with additional image generation and local-image vision capabilities through the ChatGPT Codex transport.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 ChatGPT Codex 传输的网页搜索、图像生成和本地图片理解工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with web search, image generation, and local-image understanding tools backed by the ChatGPT Codex transport.

capabilities: Searches the public web and returns model-generated summaries with source URLs
Generates bitmap images through the ChatGPT Codex endpoint
Reads workspace-local image files and sends them for vision analysis
Uses ChatGPT/Codex credentials, refreshes OAuth tokens, and may persist refreshed login state
Performs network requests to auth.openai.com and chatgpt.com
